lm_output: The word "agha" entered English from Turkish, and the Turkish word comes from the Old Turkic "aqa," meaning "elder brother." It is an equivalent of the Mongolian word "aqa" or "aka." Other uses "Agha" is nowadays used as a common Persian honorific title. Carlos Fonseca explained to him, the original had been lost, so they decided to look for the one closest to the sequence - taken a second before or after the other - to replace it. "It was almost the same," he said, "only in this one I had a lost look."
